correctness.rationale: Theorem 4.13 yields formula (1) for all r>=2,n>=0. Ordered-composition EGFs yield equation (2); differentiation yields recurrence (4). Monicity, constant term and the sign match at the interlacing roots are checked algebraically. The sign of the extra term r(r-2)n is nonnegative for precisely the claimed domain; the argument produces n+1 distinct negative roots and strict interlacing. Standard Newton inequalities yield strict normalized log-concavity. The exact-integer checker confirms two independent formulas versus recurrence for 54 small instances.
